goal: Fix <finding> now, or defer it: <one line naming the finding and the work it is outside of>

constraints.description: This session is permitted to edit the files the fix would touch
constraints.lifted_by: <the event that grants it — a coordinator widening the authorization scope, the sibling worker who owns the file landing, the next session starting without that bar>

options.label: Fix it in this run
options.description: <the smallest change that removes the finding, named>

options.label: Record it and route it to its owner
options.description: A roadmap item or a tracker row, captured through its own skill, plus a record in .claude/docs/out-of-scope/

criteria.label: Cost to the next session or agent
criteria.description: What the next worker pays under this option: hitting it by default, re-establishing the context that found it, or nothing

criteria.label: Residual silence
criteria.description: How quietly the finding fails under this option. A clean verdict it cannot support scores at the top; a loud crash scores low

criteria.label: Contamination of later work
criteria.description: Does other work land on the bad foundation while this option holds

criteria.label: Cost to the run in hand
criteria.description: The edit, its tests, its review, and the interruption to the work that found it

criteria.label: Scope integrity
criteria.description: Does the option keep the declared scope meaning what it says (CLAUDE.md item 8)

criteria.label: Reversibility of the option
criteria.description: How cheap it is to have been wrong about this option and change course
